question: How do provisional means lead the deluded toward the real?
premises: Children are led clearly into the real nature of sound through written letters.
The letters are provisional aids, not the final reality.
In the same way, the deluded are led gradually by provisional means.
inference: Provisional means function pedagogically to lead the unprepared toward the real.
plain_english: Just as children are clearly led into the real nature of sound through written letters, so the deluded are gradually led by those provisional means.
